// SYNTAX TEST "source.ds"

// types / dynamic / erased fields
struct Logger {
// <- keyword.declaration.type.ds
    writer: Dynamic<Writer>;
//          ^^^^^^^ entity.name.type.ds
}

// types / dynamic / erased storage
const erased: Dynamic<Writer> = console;
// <- keyword.declaration.type.ds

// types / dynamic / universal values
struct ErasedEvent {
// <- keyword.declaration.type.ds
    payload: Dynamic<unknown>;
//           ^^^^^^^ entity.name.type.ds
}

// types / dynamic / narrowing
if (erased is Console) {
// <- keyword.control.conditional.ds
    erased.written satisfies uint;
}
